place: Langsuan Road, Lumpini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok, Thailand
title: Scope Langsuan — One-Bedroom 29th-Floor Residence
blurb: A generous 84 m² one-bedroom on the 29th floor of Scope Langsuan, the Kohn Pedersen Fox–designed tower on Langsuan Road. Private-lift entry, floor-to-ceiling glass and panoramic city views, currently let at ฿160,000 a month — a turnkey investment on one of Bangkok's finest addresses. Freehold under the foreign quota. ฿42,000,000.
detail:
At 84 m², this is a notably large one-bedroom, arranged on the 29th floor with a private lift opening into the apartment. An open-plan living, dining and kitchen area sits behind floor-to-ceiling glass with panoramic views across the Langsuan district and the skyline, alongside a double bedroom, a full bathroom and a separate powder room. The finish is the same warm palette of stone, timber and bronze found throughout the building.

Scope Langsuan stands on Langsuan Road in Lumpini, a short walk from Ploenchit BTS, Central Embassy and Lumpini Park, on a plot that set Bangkok's land-price record in 2019. The tower's sculpted façade is the work of New York firm Kohn Pedersen Fox, and residents share a private 25-seat Dolby Atmos screening room and an inclusive three-times-weekly housekeeping service.

The residence is currently tenanted at ฿160,000 per month, a gross yield of roughly 4.6%, making it a ready-to-hold investment as well as a pied-à-terre. It is available freehold under the foreign-ownership quota. Lease terms, floor plan and title details are available on request.
